title: Add Testimonials
content: Build testimonials/reviews section with multiple layout options. Card structure: quote icon (Quote from lucide-react) or quotation marks, testimonial text in italic or regular weight, rating stars if applicable, author section with avatar (rounded-full w-12 h-12), name, title/company. Layout variants: single featured testimonial, grid of cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3), horizontal carousel with navigation. Add visual variety: different card backgrounds, accent borders, varied avatar sizes. Include company logo option. Star rating component with filled/empty states. Animate cards on scroll. Consider video testimonial option with play button overlay.

variants.simple: Build a testimonials section with quotes, avatars, and ratings.
variants.detailed: Build testimonials/reviews section with multiple layout options. Card structure: quote icon (Quote from lucide-react) or quotation marks, testimonial text in italic or regular weight, rating stars if applicable, author section with avatar (rounded-full w-12 h-12), name, title/company. Layout variants: single featured testimonial, grid of cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3), horizontal carousel with navigation. Add visual variety: different card backgrounds, accent borders, varied avatar sizes. Include company logo option. Star rating component with filled/empty states. Animate cards on scroll. Consider video testimonial option with play button overlay.
variants.advanced: Build testimonials/reviews section with multiple layout variants and engaging design. Card structure: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 or p-8, relative for quote decoration. Quote icon: absolute -top-4 -left-4 text-4xl text-blue-600/20, or large " quotation marks. Testimonial text: text-gray-700 leading-relaxed, can be italic for stylistic effect, line-clamp-4 if needed. Star rating: flex gap-0.5 mb-4, Star icons filled (text-yellow-400) or outline (text-gray-300). Author section: flex items-center gap-4 mt-6, avatar (w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover), text (name font-semibold, role/company text-sm text-gray-500). Company logo: optional grayscale logo next to or below author. Layout variants: 1) Single featured: large centered card with larger text and avatar, 2) Grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6, 3) Carousel: horizontal scroll or animated slider with navigation dots/arrows, 4) Masonry: varying card heights for visual interest. Visual variety: alternate card backgrounds (white, gray-50, blue-50), colored left border (border-l-4 border-blue-500), shadow variations. Video testimonial: card with video thumbnail, play button overlay, opens modal or inline player. Floating design: cards at slight angles or overlapping for dynamic feel. Section header: "What our customers say", centered with optional subtitle. Trust indicators: "Trusted by 10,000+ customers", average rating badge. Scroll animations: cards fade in and slide up when scrolled into view with stagger delay. Responsive: single column on mobile, adjust text sizes. ACCESSIBILITY: blockquote element for testimonial text, cite for author, proper alt text on avatars. Consider testimonial rotation for pages with many reviews.
